body.en: When administrators configure tagging tools for teams in a Slack integration, form stability in admin settings is essential. Enterprise organizations with Slack connected now see a dismissible link to API documentation on admin settings tabs, making integration guidelines easy to consult at any time. On plugin and skill configuration pages, clicking Retry after a failed load preserves previously unsaved access changes in input fields instead of wiping them out upon reloading. In addition, the repositories control fixes an issue where menus listed identical actions twice, so the menu now lists only functions not already covered by the primary button. While retrying connections when configuring permissions previously risked losing manual input, form state is now more resilient and menu options are far more precise.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added a dismissible link to the Claude Tag API docs on the Bundles and Channels tabs in admin settings, for Enterprise organizations with Slack connected
[Claude Tag] Fixed Retry on plugin and skill pages in Claude Tag admin settings discarding unsaved access changes after a failed load; your edits now stay in place
[Claude Tag] Fixed the repositories control in Claude Tag admin settings showing the same action twice; its menu now lists only what the button doesn't already do

title.zh-TW: 修復 Slack 跨工作區重啟，等待執行器主動在討論串發布提示
title.en: Fix cross-workspace Slack restarts and post thread notices while waiting for runners

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 團隊頻道中直接呼叫 Claude 協作時，跨企業群組的權限與訊息同步若不穩定，容易造成溝通中斷。在跨工作區的共用頻道中輸入 `@Claude !restart`，遇到檢查失敗時會自動重試一次，並在需要時主動引導你重新執行。短時間內重複透過相同連結綁定帳號時，不會再發送重複的確認私人訊息與頻道通知。⟦宛如跨國視訊會議中的智慧助理，連線不穩時主動重試連線，遇到伺服器排隊會貼心告知目前進度，不再在螢幕前無聲沉默。⟧當工作階段在背景等待自託管執行器時，會在討論串中主動發布等待通知，讓成員知道任務正在排隊而非卡死。在雙方企業皆安裝了 Claude 的外部共用頻道中，也能如常回應專屬討論串中的標記。
body.en: When collaborating with Claude directly in Slack team channels, unstable permissions and message synchronization across enterprise groups can easily disrupt communication. Entering `@Claude !restart` in channels shared across workspaces automatically retries once if a check fails, guiding you to run it again when necessary. Connecting accounts repeatedly via the same link within a short window no longer sends duplicate confirmation direct messages or channel notifications. ⟦Serving as an intelligent assistant in a multi-party conference, it actively retries when connections drop and posts status updates while waiting in server queues instead of sitting in silence.⟧ When a session waits for a self-hosted runner in the background, it actively posts a wait notice in the thread so members know the task is queued rather than frozen. In external shared channels where both organizations have installed Claude, it also responds normally to tags inside dedicated threads.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed `@Claude !restart` giving up after one failed workspace check in channels shared across Enterprise Grid workspaces; it now retries, then asks you to run it again
[Claude Tag] Fixed a second confirmation DM and channel note when you connect your Claude account from Slack twice from the same link within a few minutes
[Claude Tag] Fixed follow-up messages in Slack showing no sign of progress while Claude's session waits for a self-hosted runner; Claude now posts a wait notice in the thread
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude sometimes not answering a tag in its own thread in Slack Connect channels where both organizations have installed Claude

title.zh-TW: 應用程式閘道支援自訂 OIDC 欄位辨識使用者
title.en: Claude Apps Gateway Supports Custom OIDC Claims to Identify Users

body.zh-TW: 企業為內部工具設定單一登入時，各家身分識別系統採用的欄位往往不太一樣。Claude 應用程式閘道新增了 `oidc.user_id_claim` 設定鍵，允許管理者透過 `sub` 以外的宣告來辨識人員身分，例如 Microsoft Entra ID 常用的 `oid`。⟦跟寄物櫃取件一樣，以前驗證系統硬性規定只認預設單號，現在能指定改認會員編號來辨識每位使用者。⟧這讓你在使用身分權杖（id_token，用於驗證身分的授權令牌）時，不再受限於預設識別碼，只要指定 `oid` 這類欄位，就能用它來辨識使用者。
body.en: When setting up single sign-on for internal tools, enterprise identity systems often adopt different fields. Claude apps gateway added the `oidc.user_id_claim` setting key, allowing administrators to identify people by a claim other than `sub`, such as Microsoft Entra ID's `oid`. ⟦Much like locker pickup where verification previously strictly required the default receipt number, the system now accepts a member ID to identify each user.⟧ This ensures that when working with an identity token (id_token, an authorization credential used to verify identity), you are no longer constrained by the default identifier, and specifying a field such as `oid` allows you to identify users directly.

items.original: Added `oidc.user_id_claim` to the Claude apps gateway, to identify people by an id_token claim other than `sub`, such as Microsoft Entra ID's `oid`

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕模式支援點擊提示立即送出排隊訊息
title.en: Fullscreen Mode Supports Clicking the Hint to Send Queued Messages Right Away

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟全螢幕讓 Claude Code 專心執行長任務時，常會順手在底下排入下一段想問的內容。在全螢幕模式下，排隊中的訊息下方會顯示「立即送出（to send now）」提示字樣，現在直接拿滑鼠點擊這行提示，就能跟按鍵一樣立刻把訊息送出。⟦像在得來速排隊點餐一樣，以前只能等候依序叫號處理，現在只要輕點取餐口提示燈就能立刻把訂單送進廚房。⟧當你單手拿著滑鼠瀏覽輸出畫面時，不必再把手移回鍵盤摸索快速鍵，直接在畫面上點一下就能接續對話。
body.en: When opening fullscreen to let Claude Code focus on long tasks, you might often queue up your next question below. In fullscreen mode, a "to send now" hint appears under a queued message, and clicking this hint with your mouse now sends it right away, just as its key does. ⟦Picture drive-thru ordering where cars once had to wait for their turn in sequence, whereas now tapping a pickup window light sends the order into the kitchen instantly.⟧ When browsing the output with one hand on the mouse, you no longer need to move your hand back to the keyboard to hunt for shortcuts, since a single click on the screen lets you continue the conversation.

items.original: Added click to send: in fullscreen, clicking the "to send now" hint under a queued message sends it right away, as its key does

title.zh-TW: 寫入工具防止截斷大檔，避免覆寫專案規則與引用的檔案
title.en: Write Tool Prevents Truncating Large Files and Avoids Overwriting Project Rules or Included Files

body.zh-TW: 如果專案根目錄或子目錄裡的 `CLAUDE.md`、規則檔或 `@` 引用的設定檔內容很長，你可能會擔心模型改動檔案時遺失後續內容。以前 Claude 在只看見檔案開頭的情況下，偶爾會直接覆寫子目錄中體積龐大的規則檔或引用檔案。⟦好比校對厚重合約時，以前助理只翻了首頁就直接重寫整份文件，現在校對規則要求必須讀完全本或在原處訂正。⟧這個問題已經修好，寫入工具（Write 工具，專門建立或覆寫檔案的工具）現在會要求 Claude 讀完整份檔案，或就地編輯，不再隨意整份覆寫。
body.en: If a `CLAUDE.md`, rules file, or `@`-included configuration file in the project root or a subdirectory is very long, you might worry about losing subsequent content when the model edits files. Previously, after seeing only the start of a file, Claude occasionally overwrote a very large rules file or included file in a subdirectory. ⟦Think of proofreading a hefty contract where an assistant previously skimmed only the front page before rewriting the entire document, but revision rules now require reading the whole text or making corrections in place.⟧ This issue has now been resolved, and the Write tool (a built-in utility dedicated to creating or replacing files) now asks Claude to read it all or edit in place, preventing unintended full overwrites.

items.original: Fixed Claude overwriting a very large CLAUDE.md, rules file or @-included file in a subdirectory after seeing only its start; Write now asks Claude to read it all or edit in place

title.zh-TW: 思考力度顯示以生效值為準，並精準提示設定與快取重新讀取時機
title.en: Effort Displays Now Reflect Levels in Force with Accurate Warnings for Setting and Cache Re-reads

body.zh-TW: 在任務執行中途調整思考力度或切換模型時，狀態列上的提示現在能更誠實地反映背後進度。以前在任務中途變更思考力度，等待旋轉圖示、OpenTelemetry 遙測數據與對話紀錄會搶先顯示新選取的數值；現在一律顯示當前真正生效的層級。輸入提示區的思考力度指示器也獲得改善，任務中途修改時會提示可能需等下一則訊息生效，一旦生效提示就會自動清除。此外，`/model` 與 `/effort` 的快取（暫存，把算過與查過的資料存起來重複使用）警告文字原本稱重新讀取必須等待下一則訊息，現在若在 Claude 工作期間變更，系統能提早觸發重新讀取。⟦如同開車切換行車模式，儀表板不會在剛撥動旋鈕時就虛報已生效，而是等變速箱真正換檔完畢才亮起新燈號。⟧
body.en: When adjusting effort or switching models mid-task, indicators on the status line now more faithfully reflect background progress. Previously, when changing effort mid-task, the spinner, OpenTelemetry telemetry data, and transcripts prematurely named a newly picked level before the model applied it; they now consistently show the level in force. The prompt's effort indicator has also been improved, so a change made mid-task now notes that it may wait for your next message, and the note clears automatically when it no longer applies. In addition, the `/model` and `/effort` cache warning originally stated that the re-read waits for your next message, but a change made while Claude is working can now trigger it sooner. ⟦Like shifting driving modes in a car, the dashboard no longer falsely claims a mode is active the moment you turn the knob, but waits until the transmission actually switches gears before lighting up the new indicator.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the spinner, OpenTelemetry `effort` values and transcripts naming a newly picked effort level during a task before the model applied it; they now show the level in force
Fixed the `/model` and `/effort` cache warning saying the re-read waits for your next message; a change made while Claude is working can trigger it sooner
Improved the prompt's effort indicator: a change made mid-task now says it may wait for your next message, and the note clears when it no longer applies

title.zh-TW: 第三方雲端部署自訂模型採用精簡提示，並納入拒絕備援切換
title.en: Third-Party Cloud Deployments Use Shorter System Prompts for Custom Models and Support Refusal Fallback

body.zh-TW:
使用 Amazon Bedrock、Google Cloud Vertex、Foundry 或 Mantle 連接 Claude Code 時，許多企業會替模型取自訂部署名稱。針對這類無法識別的模型名稱，包含自訂部署名或推論設定檔 ARN，即使底層是 Sonnet 或 Haiku，現在也會採用較短的系統提示詞。若想維持完整提示詞，可設定環境變數：

```
CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT=0
```

當訊息觸發安全標記後的自動模型切換，現在也同步涵蓋這些自訂模型名稱。若要關閉這項備援機制，可加入設定：

```
CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK=1
```

⟦正如外派特使持特殊身分出勤，通關時先給精簡版身分照會以免耽誤驗證，遇到緊急狀況也同樣享有備援安排。⟧這樣自訂部署名稱也會比照辦理。
body.en:
When connecting to Claude Code using Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex, Foundry, or Mantle, many enterprises assign custom deployment names to their models. For unrecognized model names, including custom deployment names and inference profile ARNs, Claude Code now adopts the shorter system prompt even when they front Sonnet or Haiku. To keep the full prompt, configure the environment variable:

```
CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT=0
```

Automatic model switches after a flagged message now also cover these custom model names. To turn off this fallback mechanism, configure the setting:

```
CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK=1
```

⟦A special envoy traveling under a custom diplomatic title presents a concise credential to avoid clearance delays, while remaining fully covered by emergency contingency protocols.⟧ Custom deployment names are handled in the exact same manner.

items.original:
Changed Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and Mantle to use the shorter system prompt for model names Claude Code doesn't recognize, such as custom deployment names and inference profile ARNs, even when they front Sonnet or Haiku; set `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT=0` to keep the full prompt
Changed automatic model switches after a flagged message to also cover model names Claude Code doesn't recognize, such as custom deployment names; set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK=1` to turn them off

title.zh-TW: 限制工作階段掛鉤並行上限，並允許子代理縮小自動壓縮視窗
title.en: Session Hook Concurrency Is Capped While Subagents Can Lower Auto-Compact Windows

body.zh-TW: 為專案串接大量自動化檢查流程時，頻繁觸發的事件可能會同時佔用系統大量背景運算資源。現在每個工作階段在包含所有子代理的情況下，輸入提示與代理人掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），同時間最多只能執行 24 個，外加最多 12 個等待時間超出該事件逾時長度的掛鉤。⟦仿效遊樂園熱門設施的管制閘門，同一時段只准固定名額進場以免擠爆動線，各分館還能自行縮短排隊等待時間。⟧如果設定的逾時低於 1 秒會以 1 秒計算；子代理的 `autoCompactWindow` 也能調低全域設定 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW`，讓子代理提早壓縮對話歷程，但依然無法將其調高。
body.en: When wiring extensive automated check workflows into a project, frequently triggered events can simultaneously consume substantial background computing resources. Now, prompt and agent hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) run at most 24 at a time per session, subagents included, plus at most 12 that have waited longer than their event's timeout. ⟦Theme park turnstiles cap simultaneous entries during peak hours to keep pathways clear, while individual pavilions can shorten their own queue wait times.⟧ A configured timeout under 1 second now counts as 1 second; a subagent's `autoCompactWindow` can also lower the window set by `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW` to compact history earlier, though it still never raises that window.

items.original:
Changed prompt and agent hooks to run at most 24 at a time per session, sub-agents included, plus at most 12 that have waited longer than their event's timeout; a `timeout` under 1 second now counts as 1 second
Changed a subagent's `autoCompactWindow` to lower the window set by `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW`, where it had no effect before; it still never raises that window

title.zh-TW: 遙測指標如實標註市集外部工具名稱，並移除多餘安全事件
title.en: Telemetry Accurately Names Marketplace External Tools and Removes Redundant Safety Events

body.zh-TW: 負責監控系統運作狀態的工程團隊，現在能從日誌中更精確掌握各項外掛工具的調用情形。官方市集宣告的固定網址遠端 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，屬性 `mcp_server.name` 不再顯示為 `custom`，而是回報真實名稱。⟦比照公司訪客名冊的登記方式，經過認證的特約包商會直接印出真實行號，不再一律以臨時外包商統稱標註。⟧同時，Claude Code 已經停止發送 `claude_code.safety_event` 遙測事件，讓維運人員在排查追蹤鏈時減少多餘雜訊。
body.en: Engineering teams monitoring system operational health can now track plugin tool invocations in logs with greater precision. For fixed-URL remote MCP (Model Context Protocol, which connects AI models to external tools) servers declared by plugins from the official marketplace, the `mcp_server.name` attribute reports their real name instead of `custom`. ⟦Corporate visitor logs register certified contractors by their actual company names rather than grouping every guest under a generic vendor label.⟧ Meanwhile, Claude Code has stopped sending the `claude_code.safety_event` telemetry event, eliminating unnecessary noise when operators investigate trace spans.

items.original:
Changed OpenTelemetry `mcp_server.name` to report the real name of fixed-URL remote MCP servers declared by plugins from the official Anthropic marketplace, instead of `custom`
Changed Claude Code to stop sending the `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry event

title.zh-TW: 終端機輸入與 Vim 編輯修復，離開與刪除游標行為更精確
title.en: Terminal Input and Vim Editing Fixes Ensure Accurate Exit and Cursor Actions

body.zh-TW: 習慣在終端機內快速敲擊鍵盤指令的使用者，有時會遇到游標與編輯狀態未能即時更新的小困擾。現在幾處輸入問題已獲得修復。在 Agent 檢視畫面中，如果離開前剛用 Ctrl+C 清空了輸入文字，下次啟動時不會再莫名其妙恢復那些文字。如果從空的 `!` 輸入列按下 Ctrl+D 離開，下次重新開啟時也不會再次誤進入 Shell 模式。另外，在 Vim 編輯模式下，使用 `d`、`c` 或 `y` 搭配 `gj` 或 `gk` 且指定行數大於剩餘行數時，以前會誤刪或誤複製文字，現在比照標準 Vim 行為，只單純移動游標。⟦就像在打字機前清空草稿夾，撕掉的廢紙不會在下次開機時重新夾回滾輪，跳過空白行時也不會誤裁紙張。⟧
body.en: Users accustomed to typing commands rapidly in the terminal sometimes run into minor quirks where cursor and editing states fail to update promptly. Several input issues have now been resolved. In agent view, if input text was cleared with Ctrl+C just before exiting, it will no longer be unexpectedly restored on the next launch. Exiting with Ctrl+D from an empty `!` input line no longer causes agent view to reopen in shell mode. Additionally, in Vim mode, using `d`, `c`, or `y` with a `gj` or `gk` count larger than the lines left previously deleted or copied text by mistake; like standard Vim, they now only move the cursor. ⟦Emptying a typewriter tray ensures torn drafts never reload onto the platen upon restarting, and skipping past empty lines prevents cutting into the sheet.⟧

items.original:
Fixed agent view restoring input text on the next launch after it was cleared with Ctrl+C just before exiting
Fixed agent view reopening in shell mode after exiting with Ctrl+D from an empty `!` input
Fixed vim mode `d`, `c` and `y` with a `gj` or `gk` count larger than the lines left deleting or copying text; like Vim, they now only move the cursor

title.zh-TW: 深入目錄仍能識別自訂技能，指令選單與載入機制修復
title.en: Custom Skills Remain Reachable Deep in Directories Alongside Command Menu and Loading Fixes

body.zh-TW: 跨多個專案目錄切換工作時，自訂的自動化技能與指令選單現在能更穩定地維持運作。以前在 Git 儲存庫中透過 Bash 執行 `cd` 切換到深層子目錄後，個別目錄專用與 `paths:` 設定的自訂技能會找不到，現在即使切換路徑也能正確識別。如果存在名稱不合法的自訂指令，過去會導致所有指令全部停止載入，甚至讓 `claude -p` 無法輸出任何內容，這個載入中斷問題已經修好。此外，`/verify` 指令在 `/help` 與 `/` 選單中，原本會誤顯示專供 Claude 閱讀的冗長說明，現在已經改為精簡白話的短描述。⟦有如百貨商場的各樓層導覽手冊，即使走進地下街也能查到專櫃位置，單一店家登記有誤也不會讓整面導覽看板黑屏。⟧
body.en: When switching between multiple project directories, custom automated skills and command menus now operate more reliably. Previously, running `cd` in Bash deeper into a Git repository caused per-directory and `paths:` custom skills not to be found; they are now recognized properly even after navigating deeper. A custom command with an invalid name previously stopped all commands from loading, which could leave `claude -p` with no output; this loading disruption has been fixed. Furthermore, `/verify` previously showed a long description meant for Claude in `/help` and the `/` command menu instead of a concise summary, but it now provides a short description. ⟦Department store floor directories still locate boutique counters even down in the basement arcade, while a clerical typo for a single shop no longer blacks out the entire electronic directory board.⟧

items.original:
Fixed per-directory and `paths:` skills not being found after a Bash `cd` deeper into a git repository
Fixed a command with an invalid name stopping all commands from loading, which could leave `claude -p` with no output
Fixed `/verify` showing a long description meant for Claude in `/help` and the `/` command menu instead of a short one

title.zh-TW: 釐清工作階段等待狀態與額度名稱，修復歷程恢復與暫存清理衝突
title.en: Session Waiting States and Usage Limits Clarified alongside History Resume and Cleanup Fixes

body.zh-TW: 重新開啟先前的對話或接續處理工作時，狀態清單與對話歷程現在能更忠實反映真實情況。過去在終端機恢復工作階段（session，代表一次完整的對話歷程）後，極端情況下首則回覆可能在下一次恢復時消失，這個問題已經解決。同時，讀取工具處理 PDF 頁面時，若恰好碰上舊工作階段檔案清理，不再報出影像寫入失敗錯誤。若最後一則訊息僅在句中順便提及需要等待的項目，工作階段清單也不會再誤判為正在等待你回應。此外，用量上限提示正式將 5 小時窗口稱為「5 小時限制」，取代容易讓人誤會的「工作階段限制」。⟦宛若病歷檔案室的借閱管制，清理過期文件時不再誤抽借閱中的報告，候診名冊也不會因為隨口提及等待而誤掛紅牌。⟧
body.en: When reopening earlier conversations or continuing tasks, status listings and conversation histories now faithfully reflect actual conditions. Previously, in rare cases after resuming a session (a complete conversation history) in the terminal, the first reply could be missing the next time the session was resumed; this problem has been resolved. Meanwhile, when the Read tool processes PDF pages, running clean-up of old session files at the same time no longer causes image write failures. If the last message only mentions items waiting on you mid-sentence, the session list no longer mistakenly marks the session as waiting on you. In addition, usage limit messages now formally refer to the 5-hour window as the "5-hour limit" instead of the confusing "session limit." ⟦Medical archive controls prevent active consultation files from being purged during routine record disposal, while patient triage boards avoid tagging individuals as pending based on casual remarks.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a rare case where the first reply after resuming a session in the terminal could be missing the next time the session was resumed
Fixed the Read tool sometimes failing on PDF pages with "pdftoppm failed: Could not write image" when the clean-up of old session files ran at the same time
Fixed some sessions showing as waiting on you when the last message only mentioned items waiting on you mid-sentence
Changed usage limit messages to call the 5-hour window the "5-hour limit" instead of the "session limit"

title.zh-TW: VS Code 擴充套件完善組織設定載入，額度重設明確標註鐘點時間
title.en: VS Code Extension Refines Organization Settings Loading, Clearly Marking Usage Limit Resets with Clock Times

body.zh-TW: 於 VS Code 編輯器內使用 Claude Code 擴充套件時，企業帳號的登入與授權狀態現在變得更清楚。以前從擴充套件完成登入後，後續的工作階段可能會遺漏抓取受管理的組織設定與公司原則；現在登入後會完整同步。若在啟動階段遇到組織設定載入失敗或被拒絕，終端機分頁不再只拋出冷冰冰的結束代碼就突然關閉，而是會明確寫出失敗原因，並直接提供「重試」與「重新登入」兩個按鈕。此外，當觸發用量限制時，重設提示會明確寫出「5 小時限制」，並附上像「下午 3:10 重設」這類具體的鐘點時間，方便安排後續工作。⟦比方專案成員在內部簽核系統登入，身分驗證卡住時視窗會顯示具體原因並附上重試按鈕，重設等待時間也直接換算成幾點幾分。⟧
body.en: When using the Claude Code extension inside the VS Code editor, sign-in and authorization status for enterprise accounts is now clearer. Previously, after signing in from the extension, subsequent sessions could miss fetching managed organization settings and company policies; they are now fully synced after signing in. If loading organization settings fails or is refused at startup, the terminal tab no longer abruptly closes on a bare exit code, but instead explicitly states the failure reason and directly offers "Retry" and "Sign in again" buttons. Additionally, when triggering usage limits, the reset notice explicitly says "5-hour limit" and includes a specific clock time such as "Resets at 3:10 PM", making it easier to plan upcoming work. ⟦Imagine an employee signing into an internal approval portal: when authentication stalls, the window explains the exact issue alongside retry options, and the wait time displays as an exact hour and minute.⟧

items.original:
Fixed managed settings and organization policy not being fetched for the rest of the session after signing in from the VS Code extension
[VSCode] Fixed sessions ending on a bare exit code when your organization's settings couldn't be loaded or were refused at startup; the tab now says why and offers Retry or Sign in again
[VSCode] Changed usage limit resets to show a clock time ("Resets at 3:10 PM") and to say "5-hour limit"

title.zh-TW: 雲端例行工作支援設定思考力度，安裝腳本框升級專用編輯器
title.en: Cloud Routines Support Configuring Effort Levels, Upgrading Setup Script Boxes to Dedicated Editors

body.zh-TW: 管理在雲端定期排程執行的例行任務時，設定介面與編輯流程現在操作起來更加順手。在建立或修改雲端例行工作（routine）時，模型選單新增了思考力度選項，方便指定任務需要的推理深度。在雲端環境設定中，安裝腳本區塊升級為具備語法色彩標示、行號以及複製按鈕的專用 Bash 編輯器。在互動流程方面，於例行工作清單點選編輯時，不會再發生只跳轉頁面卻沒彈出編輯視窗的問題。如果建立雲端環境失敗，錯誤訊息也會直接顯示在對話視窗內，不再只飄在對話框外的角落提示。⟦恰似在線上表單填寫報修單，遇到錯誤時提示會直接標在填寫框旁，安裝腳本區也換成了帶行號的高級專用筆記欄。⟧
body.en: When managing scheduled routine tasks running in the cloud, configuration interfaces and editing workflows now operate much more smoothly. When creating or editing a cloud routine, the model picker adds an effort level option, making it convenient to specify the reasoning depth required for the task. In cloud environment settings, the setup script box has been upgraded to a dedicated Bash editor equipped with syntax colors, line numbers, and a Copy button. Regarding interaction flow, clicking Edit from a routine's menu no longer navigates to the page without opening its editing dialog. If creating a cloud environment fails, error messages now appear directly inside the dialog rather than merely floating as a toast notification outside of it. ⟦Consider filing a repair ticket on a web form: validation errors highlight right beside the input box, while the notes area turns into a specialized notebook with numbered lines.⟧

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Added an effort level to the model picker when you create or edit a routine that runs in the cloud
[Cloud sessions] Added a Bash editor with colors, line numbers and a Copy button to the setup script box in cloud environment settings
[Cloud sessions] Fixed a failed cloud environment creation showing its error only as a toast outside the open dialog; it now appears inside the dialog
[Cloud sessions] Fixed Edit in a routine's menu on the Routines page going to the routine's page without opening its edit dialog

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段採用伺服器命名，釐清連線限制並以表格呈現程式碼庫
title.en: Cloud Sessions Adopt Server-Assigned Names, Clarifying Connection Limits and Presenting Repositories in Tables

body.zh-TW: 透過指令列建立遠端雲端任務並抓取網路資料時，錯誤訊息與執行歷程現在呈現得更清楚。從終端機 CLI 啟動的雲端工作階段，工作階段名稱與分支名稱現在統一由伺服器端配發。當 Claude 將專案程式碼庫加入雲端時，展開該步驟會以結構清楚的簡短表格呈現結果，不再直接倒出雜亂的 JSON 原始碼。若連線失敗後不改文字直接重新發送訊息，先前偶爾會重複執行兩次的問題已獲得修正。此外，在雲端工作階段使用網路擷取功能時，若目標主機無法解析，提示會直接說明該主機可能不在允許的網域清單內，並指名需要放行的主機名稱。⟦同向遠端辦公室派發工單一樣，信件編號全由總部統一編發，包裹清單用整齊表格列出，遇到收件地址受阻也會寫明需開通的路名。⟧
body.en: When creating remote cloud tasks and fetching web data via the command line, error messages and execution histories are now presented much more clearly. For cloud sessions started from the terminal CLI, session names and branch names are now uniformly assigned by the server. When Claude adds a project repository to a cloud session, expanding that step displays the result in a well-structured short table instead of dumping messy raw JSON. If an unchanged message was resent after a failed send, an issue where it occasionally ran twice has been resolved. Furthermore, when using web fetching in cloud sessions, if a destination host fails to resolve, the prompt now explicitly explains that the host may fall outside allowed network domains and names the specific host that needs to be allowed. ⟦Just like dispatching work orders to a branch office, document numbers are issued centrally by headquarters, package manifests appear in orderly tables, and blocked deliveries note the exact street name that requires clearance.⟧

items.original:
Improved WebFetch errors in cloud sessions: a host that does not resolve is now explained as possibly outside the allowed network domains, so Claude names the host to allow
Changed cloud sessions started from the CLI to get their names and branch names from the server
[Cloud sessions] Improved the step shown when Claude adds a repository to a cloud session: opening it now shows a short table of what happened instead of raw JSON
[Cloud sessions] Fixed resending an unchanged message after a failed send in a cloud session sometimes running it twice

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制連線中斷後狀態如實標註為閒置
title.en: Remote Control Sessions Accurately Report Idle Status After Disconnections

body.zh-TW: 若暫時將電腦休眠或切換網路，遠端工作階段面板的運作狀態現在不會再給出錯誤資訊。以前未封存的遠端控制工作階段在連線中斷後，會一直停留並顯示為「工作中（working）」，直到電腦重新連線為止。現在這個問題已經修好，中斷連線時會直接切換為「閒置（idle）」狀態，讓你一眼確認連線已暫停。⟦跟辦公室的通話燈號一樣，以前電話掛斷後燈號還死抓著通話中不放，讓人誤以為對方還在線上；現在斷線立刻亮起待命燈，狀態一清二楚。⟧
body.en: If a computer is temporarily put to sleep or switches networks, the operational status in the remote session panel no longer displays inaccurate information. Previously, after a connection dropped, an unarchived Remote Control session would linger and show as "working" until the computer reconnected. This issue has now been resolved, and disconnecting immediately switches the status to "idle", allowing you to confirm at a glance that the connection is paused. ⟦An office on-air lamp demonstrates the difference: previously, hanging up the phone left the indicator stuck on active call, misleading coworkers into thinking someone was still talking; now, dropping the connection immediately lights up a standby bulb with unmistakable clarity.⟧

items.original: [Remote Control] Fixed an unarchived Remote Control session showing as working until a computer reconnected; it now shows as idle

title.zh-TW: Slack 頻道轉公開保留專屬設定，精確投遞檔案並具體說明重試原因
title.en: Slack Channels Retain Custom Settings When Going Public, Delivering Files Accurately and Detailing Retry Reasons

body.zh-TW: 團隊在 Slack 平台中透過標籤呼叫 Claude 時，各頻道的專屬設定與多討論串回覆現在更加穩定。以前當舊的私密頻道轉為公開並換發新編號時，頻道的開關狀態與自訂代理人設定會意外跌回工作區預設值，現在設定將完整保留。同時，當環境的網路連線設定為 None 時，先前 Claude 完全無法回覆的問題也已修好。如果在同一個頻道的不同討論串同時互動，過去偶爾會把檔案上傳到錯誤的討論串，現在投遞位置已獲得修正。此外，API 失敗的重試通知不再只顯示抽象錯誤，而是會具體說明是哪個模型正在回應，或明確指出是觸發了頻率上限。⟦類似團隊通訊群組的分流派工，群組轉公開時原本的專有權限不會被強制重置，傳送附件也能準確投遞到對應的發言話題底下。⟧
body.en: When teams mention Claude via Claude Tag in Slack, channel-specific configurations and multi-thread responses are now much more reliable. Previously, when an older private channel became public and received a new ID, the channel's on/off switch and agent settings unintentionally fell back to workspace defaults; these settings are now fully retained. Meanwhile, when an environment's network access was set to None, an issue where Claude failed to reply entirely has also been fixed. If interacting across separate threads within the same channel simultaneously, files were occasionally uploaded to the wrong thread in the past, but delivery targets have now been corrected. In addition, retry notices after API failures no longer display generic API errors, instead identifying the specific model in use or stating that rate limits were hit. ⟦Dispatching tasks across team communication groups follows the same principle: opening a channel to the public preserves its specialized permissions without forced resets, and file attachments land squarely under the designated topic thread.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Improved Claude Tag's retry notice in Slack to name the model in use, or say rate limits were hit, instead of a generic API error
[Claude Tag] Fixed a Claude Tag channel's on/off switch and agent settings falling back to workspace defaults when an older private Slack channel goes public and gets a new ID
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack not replying in channels whose environment has network access set to None
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack sometimes posting a file in the wrong thread when it was answering in another thread of the same channel

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查確保檢查最新提交，消除事件延遲引發的漏審
title.en: Code Review Guarantees Checking Latest Commits, Eliminating Missed Inspections Caused by Delayed Events

body.zh-TW: 開發團隊向 GitHub 送出程式碼拉取請求時，偶爾會遇到平台事件通知延遲送達的情況。以前若 GitHub 延遲推送事件，程式碼審查（Code Review，自動檢查程式碼品質的工具）可能會去審查過期的舊提交，甚至完全略過檢查。現在這個問題已經修好，審查工具一律以 Pull Request 當前最新的提交內容為準。⟦就像助教批改作業，以前若收件通知晚送達，助教可能會拿出過期的舊草稿甚至漏改；現在一律核對抽屜裡最新繳交的版本，不再看錯稿件。⟧
body.en: When development teams submit pull requests to GitHub, platform event notifications can occasionally arrive late. Previously, if GitHub delivered a push event late, Code Review (an automated tool for inspecting code quality) could review an outdated commit or skip the inspection entirely. This issue has now been resolved, and the review tool consistently evaluates the current commit of the pull request. ⟦A teaching assistant grading student assignments illustrates the fix: previously, if submission notices arrived late, the assistant might grade an outdated draft or miss the paper entirely; now, they verify the latest submission in the drawer without reviewing the wrong draft.⟧

items.original: [Code Review] Fixed Code Review reviewing an outdated commit, or none at all, when GitHub delivered a push event late; it now reviews the pull request's current commit

title.zh-TW: 內建 Google Cloud Vertex AI 提供者，支援 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型
title.en: Built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI Provider and Support for GPT-6.1 Terra

body.zh-TW:
如果你習慣使用 Google Cloud 部署各項服務，現在可以直接透過 Vertex AI 調用模型，不用再自己撰寫複雜的轉接外掛。

設定檔只要加入：

```toml
model_provider = "gcp"
```

就能直接切換為內建的 Google Cloud Vertex AI 提供者。同時，官方模型清單也加入了最新推出的 GPT-6.1 Terra，讓你在挑選模型時有更多元的運算選擇。

⟦宛如到連鎖租車行租賃商務車隊，以前想開特定廠牌還得自己找外包車行簽約，現在官方直接納入特約合作名單，還同步上架了最新款旗艦房車供你自由挑選。⟧

當你著手建置企業內部應用，想把 AI 運算統一收整在既有的 Google Cloud 專案與帳單下，只要在設定檔指定 `gcp`，就能立刻連接 Vertex AI 資源；需要測試最新模型能力時，也能直接在清單中選用 GPT-6.1 Terra。
body.en:
If you are used to deploying services on Google Cloud, you can now call models directly through Vertex AI without writing complex adapter plugins yourself.

Simply add the following to your configuration file:

```toml
model_provider = "gcp"
```

This directly switches to the built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI provider. At the same time, the official model catalog now includes the newly released GPT-6.1 Terra, giving you more computing options when choosing models.

⟦Picture renting a commercial fleet from a car rental chain. In the past, driving a specific brand required finding and contracting with outside agencies on your own. Now the company directly adds them to its partner roster and puts the latest flagship sedan in the lineup for you to choose from.⟧

When building internal enterprise applications and consolidating AI compute under existing Google Cloud projects and billing, you only need to specify `gcp` in the configuration file to connect to Vertex AI resources immediately. When you need to test the latest model capabilities, you can also select GPT-6.1 Terra directly from the catalog.

items.original:
Added a built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI provider, configured with `model_provider = "gcp"`. (#56265)
Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the model catalogs. (#57337)

title.zh-TW: 工作階段選擇器支援儲存庫篩選，指令中心依目錄分組
title.en: Session Picker Supports Repository Filtering, Agent Command Center Groups by Directory

body.zh-TW:
當你同時在多個專案副本間切換工作時，要在落落長的工作階段清單裡找出剛剛開啟的對話往往得費一番工夫。

在搭配 Git 工作樹（讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）進行多工處理時，工作階段選擇器現在加入了儲存庫篩選機制，你可以快速過濾出屬於特定專案的工作階段。

⟦好比大型檔案庫整頓借閱卡，以前所有專案的借閱單全塞在同一個抽屜，找紀錄得一張張比對；現在能按專案名稱抽取專屬卡盒，櫃台還會按實體檔案夾分層收納。⟧

代理指令中心也同步支援目錄分組，會將關聯在同一工作樹目錄下的所有紀錄整合在一起，讓跨副本的工作階段瀏覽井然有序。當你一邊在主專案修復問題，另一邊在副本測試新功能時，只要開啟選擇器輸入專案名稱，就能切回目標對話，不再被其他專案的工作階段干擾。
body.en:
When juggling work across multiple project copies, locating a recently opened conversation in a long session list often takes considerable effort.

When multitasking with Git worktrees (a feature allowing multiple copies of the same project in parallel), the session picker now includes a repository filter, allowing you to quickly filter out sessions belonging to a specific project.

⟦Imagine a large archive reorganizing its checkout slips. Previously, slips from all projects were stuffed into a single drawer, forcing you to check records one by one. Now you can pull out a dedicated card box by project name, and the desk organizes them into tiers by physical folder.⟧

The agent command center now also supports directory grouping, bringing together all records associated with the same worktree directory to keep session navigation across copies neat and orderly. When you are fixing an issue in the main project while testing a new feature in a copy, you can simply open the picker and type the project name to switch back to the target conversation without distraction from other projects' sessions.

items.original: Added a repository filter to the session picker and directory grouping to the agent command center, making it easier to navigate sessions across linked worktrees. (#56308)

title.zh-TW: 應用伺服器 API 支援附加對話分支，實驗性拆分子討論串
title.en: App-Server API Supports Experimental Attached Thread Forks

body.zh-TW:
如果你正在透過應用伺服器介面開發專屬工具，想在同一個對話脈絡下嘗試不同解法時，管理獨立分支往往相當繁瑣。

`app-server` 的 API 現在加入了實驗性的附加對話分支（從既有對話衍生出附屬子討論串的機制）。這項功能讓應用程式能直接從既有對話拆出分支，既完整保留主線累積的上下文，又不會讓測試過程弄亂原本的紀錄。

⟦恰似在活頁筆記本貼上延伸標籤頁，以前想嘗試第二種草案只能整本重新謄寫，現在直接在關鍵頁面夾入附屬便箋，既保留原有筆記的脈絡，寫壞了也能隨時抽換。⟧

當你需要讓使用者對同一個問題評估多種修改方案時，就能透過這組介面拉出附屬討論串進行推演，讓主線對話隨時維持乾淨。
body.en:
If you are developing custom tools through the app-server interface and want to try different solutions within the same conversational context, managing separate branches can often be cumbersome.

The `app-server` API now includes experimental attached thread forks (a mechanism for branching secondary sub-threads from an existing conversation). This feature allows applications to branch directly off an existing conversation, preserving the full context accumulated in the main thread while preventing experiments from cluttering original records.

⟦Think of attaching extension tabs to a loose-leaf notebook. Previously, trying a second draft meant rewriting the entire notebook from scratch. Now you insert an attached memo directly into key pages, preserving the original context while letting you swap out bad drafts at any time.⟧

When you need users to evaluate multiple revision options for the same issue, you can use this interface to spin off secondary threads for exploration while keeping the primary conversation completely clean.

items.original: Added experimental attached thread forks to the app-server API. (#56351)

title.zh-TW: 支援對話途中調整思考力度，預設開放動態切換
title.en: Support for Adjusting Reasoning Effort Mid-Conversation, Enabled by Default

body.zh-TW:
向 AI 提問時如果一開始只隨口聊聊，隨後卻突然碰上需要抽絲剝繭的複雜架構，往往會受限於最初設定的思考程度。

針對有支援的模型，現在已經預設允許在對話途中直接修改思考力度（決定模型在回答前投入多少推理運算的參數）。你不再需要為了讓 AI 想得更深入而特地中斷對話另開新局，交談到一半隨時能依照問題難度靈活增減思考量。

⟦跟下西洋棋時切換思考時限一樣，以前開局選了快棋就只能一路快打到底，現在遇到膠著局面能當場多要幾分鐘長考，解開難題後又能切回節奏，不必把整盤棋推倒重來。⟧

當你原本只是請它解讀一段日常日誌，中途突然想探討分散式鎖的死結原因時，就能當場調高力度，讓模型針對核心邏輯進行深度推理。
body.en:
When asking an AI questions, starting with casual chat and then suddenly running into a complex architecture that demands deep dissection often leaves you constrained by your initial thinking depth.

For supported models, changing reasoning effort (the parameter determining how much reasoning computation the model invests before answering) during a conversation is now enabled by default. You no longer need to interrupt the conversation and start a new session just to make the AI think more deeply; you can flexibly adjust the amount of thinking midway based on question complexity.

⟦A chess clock adjustment reflects this transition. Previously, choosing blitz at the opening meant rushing through the entire match. Now, when a stalemate strikes, you can claim a few extra minutes on the spot to think deeply, then switch back to your normal pace once the puzzle is solved without resetting the board.⟧

When you initially ask it to interpret a routine log and suddenly decide to explore the root cause of a distributed lock deadlock midway through, you can increase the effort on the spot to let the model perform deep reasoning on the core logic.

items.original: Enabled reasoning effort changes during a conversation by default for supported models. (#56163)

title.zh-TW: 新設定檔預設啟用第二代記憶，支援匯入外部代理記憶
title.en: Fresh Profiles Enable Memory v2 by Default with Support for Importing External-Agent Memories

body.zh-TW:
每次建立新的個人設定檔時，如果希望 AI 能記住你的偏好或從其他工具轉移習慣，往往需要不少手動設定。

現在建立全新設定檔時，工具會預設啟用第二代記憶架構（讓工具跨對話保存使用者偏好的機制）。這套架構也同步支援匯入外部代理的記憶資料，能直接讀取其他 AI 工具先前累積的偏好與操作紀錄。

⟦如同搬進全新裝潢的智慧住宅，以前每次換新家都要重新訓練管家認識你的生活作息，現在進門就有現成的智慧管家隨時待命，還能直接把前任管家的備忘手冊整本讀取完畢。⟧

當你從其他開發助理切換到 Codex 時，不用再從頭教它你的排版風格與常用語法，只要把既有的記憶檔匯入，新設定檔就能立刻依循你的慣用模式工作。
body.en:
Whenever you create a new profile, having the AI remember your preferences or transfer habits from other tools usually requires considerable manual setup.

When creating fresh profiles, the tool now enables memory v2 (a mechanism allowing the tool to preserve user preferences across conversations) by default. This architecture also supports importing external-agent memories, directly reading preferences and operational logs accumulated in other AI tools.

⟦Consider moving into a newly renovated smart home. Previously, each move meant retraining a butler to learn your daily routine. Now, a ready-made smart butler is on standby the moment you enter, capable of reading through your previous butler's entire memo notebook.⟧

When switching from another coding assistant to Codex, you do not need to reteach your formatting style and preferred syntax from scratch; simply import your existing memory files, and the fresh profile will immediately work according to your established habits.

items.original: Enabled memory v2 by default for fresh profiles and added support for importing external-agent memories into it. (#56211, #56414)

title.zh-TW: 終端介面在參數錯誤時保持可編輯，新工作階段沿用預設審核者
title.en: TUI Preferences Remain Editable on Invalid Settings, Fresh Sessions Honor Default Reviewer

body.zh-TW:
在終端介面操作工具時，如果遇到執行參數填寫錯誤，偏好設定選單一旦被連帶鎖死，往往會讓人動彈不得。

針對終端使用者介面（以純文字排版的終端機視窗），現在即便執行設定中存在無效參數，偏好設定依然保持可編輯狀態，且修改後能立即生效。新開啟的終端工作階段在未提供明確覆寫時，現在也會確實遵循伺服器的預設審核者規則。

⟦彷彿汽車儀表板的設定選單，以前只要感測器回報異常數值，整個操作面板就跟著卡死無法調整；現在各項控制選項依然能隨意修改並即時生效，新發動的車輛也會主動遵循車隊預設的安全指派。⟧

無論是不慎輸入了無效路徑，或是剛啟動全新的終端對話，介面都不會再無故罷工，各項審核權限也能正常運作。
body.en:
When operating tools in a terminal interface, if execution parameters are entered incorrectly and the preference menu freezes as a result, you are often left stuck.

For the terminal user interface (a text-based terminal display), preferences now remain editable and take effect immediately even when invalid parameters exist in execution settings. Fresh terminal sessions also properly honor the server's default approval reviewer rules when no explicit override is provided.

⟦The settings menu on a car dashboard mirrors this behavior. In the past, whenever a sensor reported an abnormal reading, the entire console froze and prevented adjustments. Now control options remain fully editable with immediate effect, and newly started vehicles actively follow default safety assignments set by the fleet.⟧

Whether you accidentally enter an invalid path or just launched a brand new terminal conversation, the interface will no longer freeze without cause, and approval permissions continue to function normally.

items.original:
Fixed fresh TUI sessions to honor the server’s default approval reviewer when no explicit override is provided. (#56090)
Kept TUI preferences editable and immediately applicable when execution settings are invalid. (#56091)

title.zh-TW: 中斷與取消時即刻停止背景運算，模型找不到不再盲目重試
title.en: Promptly Stop Background Tasks on Interrupt and Cancellation, Stop Blind Retries for Missing Models

body.zh-TW:
當你在操作過程中按下停止或遇到無效請求時，背景程式如果持續空轉或重複嘗試，往往會白白消耗運算資源與等待時間。

⟦有如辦公大樓的撤銷派工機制，以前專案喊停後外包廠商依然繼續趕工，送錯地址的公文還在不斷重複投遞；現在只要前端發出取消通知，所有外派作業與無效配送都會立刻剎車。⟧

第一項改動針對遠端 MCP 工具（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）。如果本機端已經取消或不再等待回傳結果，會主動向遠端發送取消通知，避免遠端伺服器徒勞運算。

第二項調整落在代理訊息排隊機制。當你在對話中按鍵中斷執行，或是切換到計畫模式時，已排隊的訊息不會再擅自重啟工作。

第三項改動則是在模型提供者回報找不到指定型號時，工具會立即停止重複嘗試，並完整保留原本的錯誤訊息。

以前遇到操作中斷或設定失效時，背景可能會持續重試或再度喚醒任務，現在各項失效請求都能及時收手。
body.en:
When you press stop during an operation or encounter an invalid request, background processes that continue idling or repeatedly retrying waste computing resources and waiting time.

⟦An office building's dispatch cancellation mechanism works in much the same way. Previously, contractors continued rushing work after a project was halted, and misaddressed documents were repeatedly redelivered. Now, once the front desk issues a cancellation notice, all dispatched tasks and invalid deliveries brake immediately.⟧

The first change applies to remote MCP tools (protocols that connect AI to external tools). If the local side has cancelled or no longer waits for returned results, it actively sends a cancellation notice to the remote side, preventing remote servers from wasting compute.

The second adjustment targets the agent message queuing mechanism. When you press a key to interrupt execution during a conversation or switch to Plan mode, queued messages will no longer restart work without permission.

The third change stops retrying immediately when a model provider reports that a specified model was not found, fully preserving the original error message.

Previously, when operations were interrupted or settings failed, background processes might continuously retry or wake tasks back up; now invalid requests cease promptly.

items.original:
Cancelled remote MCP tool requests when their local response futures are dropped. (#56132)
Prevented queued agent messages from restarting work after an interrupt or a switch to Plan mode. (#56330)
Stopped retrying when a provider reports that a model was not found, preserving its error message. (#56445)

title.zh-TW: 市集網址驗證補強防護，防範 Git 連線至未經授權的主機
title.en: Marketplace URL Validation Strengthened to Prevent Git Connecting to Unauthorized Hosts

body.zh-TW:
從擴充市集下載外掛或套件時，工具能否嚴格把關下載來源，攸關整個開發環境的安全。

市集網址的驗證機制現在補上了防護漏洞。以往在比對網址時存在落差，可能導致 Git 最終連線的主機，與安全名單中所允許的主機並不一致。這個驗證漏洞已經補上，Git 不會再連到與允許名單所檢查的不同主機。

⟦猶如社區門禁核對訪客名單，以前警衛登記的地址和訪客實際去的地方可能對不上，現在這個對不上的漏洞已經補上。⟧

這個問題已經修好，安裝市集套件時不會再因網址歧異而誤連至未授權的外部主機。
body.en:
When downloading plugins or packages from an extension marketplace, whether a tool strictly verifies download sources is vital to the security of your entire development environment.

The marketplace URL validation mechanism has now closed a security gap. In the past, discrepancies during URL matching could cause Git to ultimately connect to a different host from the one permitted on the safe list. This validation gap has been closed, ensuring Git will no longer connect to a host different from the one checked against the allowlist.

⟦Checking visitor logs at a gated community entrance reflects this safeguard. Previously, the address recorded by a guard might not match where a visitor actually went; now this mismatch loophole has been firmly closed.⟧

This issue has been fixed, so installing marketplace packages will no longer inadvertently connect to unauthorized external hosts due to URL discrepancies.

items.original: Closed a marketplace URL validation gap that could allow Git to connect to a different host than the one checked against allowed patterns. (#56263)

title.zh-TW: /presets 新增十組快捷欄位，常用提示詞與指令隨選即用
title.en: /presets adds ten shortcut slots for instant access to frequent prompts and commands

body.zh-TW: 當你反覆在對話中輸入相同的檢查指令或固定提問時，重新打字往往耗費時間。⟦宛若汽車音響上的電台記憶功能，以前想聽固定頻道每次都要手動調頻，現在可以選取已儲存的頻道。⟧現在你可以打 `/presets` 將常用的提示詞與斜線指令儲存到十個編號欄位中。呼叫時還會跳出專屬的鍵盤選單，讓你透過鍵盤快速選取所需的預設項目。例如每次開始整理報告時，就能透過鍵盤選單選取儲存好的審查指令，省去反覆翻找與複製貼上的麻煩。
body.en: When you repeatedly enter the same inspection commands or standard questions during a conversation, retyping them is often time-consuming. ⟦Picture a car radio with station presets, where listening to a favorite channel once required manual tuning each time, but now only takes selecting a saved station.⟧ You can now type `/presets` to store frequently used prompts and slash commands into ten numbered slots. Invoking it brings up a dedicated keyboard menu so you can quickly choose the preset you need. For example, whenever you start compiling a report, you can select a saved review command through the keyboard menu, eliminating the hassle of searching around and copy-pasting.

items.original: Save reusable prompts and slash commands in ten numbered `/presets` slots, with a keyboard menu for quick access. (#54380, #54381)

title.zh-TW: /model 與 /permissions 支援行內參數，單行直接套用設定
title.en: /model and /permissions support inline arguments to apply settings in one command

body.zh-TW: 臨時需要切換模型或調整執行權限時，你可以把要用的設定直接接在指令後面。⟦如同在義式咖啡機直接轉動濃淡旋鈕，以前分開調整的出杯速度與風味濃度，現在點選飲品時順手一扭就能一併指定。⟧現在打 `/model` 或 `/permissions` 時，可以直接在同一行指令接上參數。你能直接在指令後方指定模型名稱、運算速度與推理解題力度（reasoning effort）。如果需要變更授權層級，也可以透過行內參數指定權限設定檔（permission profile）。這讓你輸入一行指令就能立刻切換到所需的執行環境。
body.en: When you need to switch models or adjust execution permissions on the fly, you can append your desired settings directly to the command. ⟦Think of turning a brew strength knob on an espresso machine, where cup speed and flavor intensity once had to be adjusted separately, but now can be set with a quick twist when selecting a beverage.⟧ When typing `/model` or `/permissions`, you can now pass arguments directly on the same line. You can specify the model name, compute speed, and reasoning effort right after the command. If you need to change authorization levels, you can also specify a permission profile through inline arguments. This lets you switch immediately to the required runtime environment with a single command.

items.original: Set model, reasoning effort, speed, and permission profiles directly with inline `/model` and `/permissions` arguments. (#54378, #54383)

title.zh-TW: 支援 Kitty 與 Sixel 協定，全螢幕紀錄直接預覽圖片
title.en: Kitty and Sixel protocols supported to preview images directly in fullscreen logs

body.zh-TW: 在純文字終端機中請 AI 產生或查看圖片時，常常必須切換到外部檢視器才能確認成果。⟦彷彿按下數位相機快門後直接在電子觀景窗回放相片，以前非得把記憶卡插進電腦螢幕才能檢視構圖，現在眼睛不用離開目鏡就能看清影像細節。⟧如果你的終端機支援 Kitty 或 Sixel 圖形協定，現在全螢幕對話紀錄中可以直接預覽圖片。無論是讓工具讀取既有的本機圖檔，或是由模型新產生的圖片，畫面都會直接在紀錄中渲染顯示，不必再特地跳出視窗開啟檔案。
body.en: When asking AI to generate or inspect images in a plain-text terminal, you often have to switch to an external viewer to verify results. ⟦Much like checking a digital camera's electronic viewfinder right after pressing the shutter, where reviewing composition once required plugging a memory card into a computer monitor, you can now inspect image details without taking your eye off the eyepiece.⟧ If your terminal supports the Kitty or Sixel graphics protocol, you can now preview images directly inside fullscreen conversation transcripts. Whether the tool reads an existing local image file or displays a new image generated by the model, the graphic renders directly within the log without opening an external window.

items.original: Preview viewed and generated images in the fullscreen transcript on terminals supporting Kitty or Sixel graphics. (#54216)

title.zh-TW: 企業級 MCP 支援專用登入與帳號授權，納入金鑰用戶端
title.en: Enterprise MCP supports dedicated login and account authorization with secret client access

body.zh-TW: 企業團隊在將內部系統串接至外部工具時，往往受限於嚴格的身分核驗與安全規範。⟦跟持員工證進入特約商務中心一樣，以前訪客通道只能辨識一般識別貼紙，現在閘門不僅支援企業總部的數位權限卡，也能核對附帶安全密鑰的專屬通行條。⟧現在企業級 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）連線支援更多元的驗證方式。你可以使用符合資格的 Codex 帳號授權直接通行，或是使用專屬登入通道完成驗證。對於需要用戶端密鑰（client secret）的 OAuth 用戶端，現在也能順利通過身分確認，安全連接各項企業服務。
body.en: When enterprise teams connect internal systems to external tools, they are often constrained by strict identity verification and security policies. ⟦Just as entering a partner business center with an employee badge once only supported basic visitor decals, the gate now accepts corporate digital access cards as well as dedicated passes with security keys.⟧ Enterprise MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) connections now support more diverse authentication methods. You can authenticate directly using eligible Codex account authorization or complete verification through dedicated login channels. OAuth clients requiring client secrets can now also pass identity verification smoothly and securely connect to various enterprise services.

items.original: Authenticate enterprise MCP connections using eligible Codex account grants or dedicated sign-in, including OAuth clients requiring secrets. (#55334, #55859, #56001)

title.zh-TW: Amazon Bedrock 設定精靈預設啟用，自動整合 AWS 登入方式
title.en: Amazon Bedrock setup wizard enabled by default to integrate AWS login methods

body.zh-TW: 初次在工具中設定雲端模型提供者時，複雜的認證流程常讓人無所適從。⟦好比智慧電視初次開機的引導流程，以前要自己翻出網路線與遙控器代碼手動輸入，現在一開機就自動跳出連線精靈，還會把同品牌的登入選項整合在同一個畫面。⟧現在 Amazon Bedrock 的設定引導精靈改為預設開啟。當系統偵測到環境中的憑證時，API 金鑰輸入選項會自動與其他 AWS 登入方式歸類在同一個區塊，讓你清楚檢視並選取合適的登入途徑，不必再四處尋找設定入口。
body.en: When configuring a cloud model provider in the tool for the first time, complex authentication flows can feel overwhelming. ⟦Consider the initial setup guide of a smart TV, where you once had to find Ethernet cables and enter remote codes manually, but now a setup wizard appears automatically and brings brand login options together on one screen.⟧ The configuration setup wizard for Amazon Bedrock is now enabled by default. When credentials are detected in the environment, the API key input option is automatically grouped into the same section alongside other AWS login methods. This allows you to clearly view and select the appropriate sign-in path without searching around for configuration menus.

items.original: The Amazon Bedrock setup wizard is now enabled by default, with API key entry grouped alongside other AWS sign-in methods when credentials are detected. (#56033, #56023)

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮失敗自動備援，恢復工作階段完整保留討論串設定
title.en: Compaction failures fall back smoothly while resumed sessions preserve thread settings

body.zh-TW: 長時間與 AI 討論累積了大量對話紀錄時，背後的摘要壓縮機制是維持流暢對答的關鍵。⟦就像編輯長篇文件時的自動存檔機制，以前存檔失敗會在草稿夾留下一半的殘缺摘要，重開檔案時個人偏好也被重設成原廠設定；現在即使背景壓縮失敗也會平穩備援，重新開啟時還能精準還原原本的排版。⟧現在對話歷史壓縮（compaction）若不幸失敗，不會再於對話紀錄中留下半截殘缺的摘要內容，背景壓縮失敗時也會安全備援而不引發程式異常崩潰。恢復工作階段（session）時，工具現在能確實找到已壓縮的歷史紀錄，並完整復原原本討論串儲存的設定，而不是擅自將它們覆蓋成全域預設值。
body.en: When extensive discussions with AI accumulate substantial conversation history, the underlying summary compaction mechanism is essential for maintaining smooth exchanges. ⟦Like an autosave feature while editing a long document, where a save failure once left a broken half-summary in drafts and reset personal preferences to factory defaults upon reopening, background compaction failures now fall back smoothly and restore original layouts upon relaunch.⟧ If conversation history compaction fails, it no longer leaves partial summary fragments in transcripts, and background compaction failures now fall back safely without triggering crashes. When resuming a session, the tool reliably finds compacted history and fully restores the thread's saved settings instead of overwriting them with global defaults.

items.original:
Failed compaction no longer leaves partial summaries in conversation history, and background compaction failures fall back without panicking. (#53932, #55581)
Resuming sessions now finds compressed histories and restores saved thread settings instead of replacing them with global defaults. (#54008, #55923)

title.zh-TW: 自動清理未使用的安裝與市集暫存，設定日誌上限釋放磁碟空間
title.en: Prune unused installs and marketplace caches while capping daemon logs to free disk space

body.zh-TW: 工具在背景持續運作或頻繁下載外掛後，磁碟空間常常在不知不覺間被暫存檔案佔滿。⟦類似手機定期執行儲存空間大掃除，以前沒在用的舊版本與未再使用的檔案包會一直堆在角落，背景服務的紀錄簿也無限膨脹；現在清理工具會主動清空廢棄包裝，並替紀錄簿設下頁數上限。⟧現在工具加入了多項磁碟維護機制來降低空間佔用。系統會主動修剪不再使用的安裝版本，清理市集中已棄置的 checkout（取出的檔案副本）。同時替常駐程式（daemon）的日誌檔案設定大小上限，防止日誌無限制增長消耗硬碟空間。
body.en: When tools run continuously in the background or download plugins frequently, disk space often fills up unnoticed with temporary files. ⟦Similar to periodic storage cleanups on a smartphone, where unused old versions and abandoned package archives once piled up in corners while background logs grew without bound, cleanup tools now purge obsolete packages and cap log pages.⟧ The tool now includes several disk maintenance mechanisms to reduce disk usage. The system actively prunes unused installation versions and cleans up abandoned marketplace checkouts (extracted working copies of files). It also sets a size limit on daemon log files to prevent logs from growing indefinitely and consuming disk storage.

items.original: Reduced disk usage by pruning unused installations, cleaning abandoned marketplace checkouts, and bounding daemon logs. (#53827, #55149, #55689, #55690, #55856)

title.zh-TW: 強化執行環境安全防護，遮蔽終端機憑證並嚴格檢驗路徑
title.en: Harden runtime security by masking terminal credentials and strictly validating paths

body.zh-TW:
在執行腳本或調用系統環境時，防止敏感資訊外洩與防堵潛在執行漏洞是保障系統安全的核心關鍵。

終端機操作方面，支援的遠端 Bash 指令與 Zsh 快照工作階段（session）現在會自動遮蔽各類憑證，包含來自自訂提供者的敏感認證金鑰，避免機密在紀錄或螢幕輸出中曝光。

沙盒防護也有所強化，針對 macOS 系統上大小寫變形的中繼資料路徑，以及用來尋找執行檔的符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔），都加入了嚴格的檢驗機制，防止路徑被惡意替換。

內嵌的 JavaScript 執行環境也完成更新，為最佳化後的 `Array.sort` 排序操作加入安全檢查，防範異常。以前在遠端執行或排查腳本時容易擔心金鑰外洩或路徑被掉包，現在各個執行環節都有專門的安全防線把關。
body.en:
When executing scripts or invoking system environments, preventing sensitive information leaks and closing potential execution vulnerabilities are essential to securing the system.

For terminal operations, supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions now automatically mask various credentials, including sensitive authentication keys from custom providers, preventing secrets from being exposed in logs or screen output.

Sandbox defenses have also been strengthened by adding strict validation mechanisms against case-variant metadata paths on macOS and symlinks (shortcut files pointing to another location) used to locate executables, preventing paths from being maliciously substituted.

The embedded JavaScript runtime has also been updated to add safety checks to optimized `Array.sort` operations, guarding against anomalies. While running or debugging scripts remotely once raised concerns about leaked keys or swapped paths, dedicated security safeguards now protect each execution stage.

items.original:
Mask credentials during supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions, including credentials from custom providers. (#54309, #54432, #56049)
Hardened sandbox checks for case-variant metadata paths on macOS and replaceable symlinks used to locate executables. (#54273, #55384)
Updated the embedded JavaScript runtime with safety checks for optimized `Array.sort` operations. (#54519)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援代理伺服器驗證，指令列設定覆寫與排隊流程修復
title.en: Windows supports proxy authentication alongside fixes for CLI config overrides and prompt queuing

body.zh-TW:
在企業網路環境或複雜的指令列流程中，連線驗證與參數傳遞的正確性直接影響工作進展。

在 Windows 系統中，HTTPS 與 WebSocket 連線現在能正確處理代理伺服器（proxy）的驗證要求，自動使用已登入使用者的 Negotiate 或 NTLM 憑證完成身分查核，避免連線失敗中斷。

在終端機執行多層子指令時，若在不同層級重複帶入 `-c` 或 `--config` 參數，現在各層級的設定覆寫值都會完整保留，不再被意外覆蓋或遺失。

排隊等待執行的提示詞也調整了執行邏輯，現在會確實等候前方擱置中的權限確認選單完成選擇，才會繼續往下執行。以前遇到內網代理或連續提問時容易卡在連線中斷或權限錯亂，現在整套指令與排程流程都能順暢運行。
body.en:
In enterprise network environments or complex command-line workflows, the reliability of connection authentication and parameter passing directly impacts work progress.

On Windows, HTTPS and WebSocket connections now properly handle proxy authentication challenges by automatically verifying identities with the logged-in user's Negotiate or NTLM credentials, preventing connection failures.

When running nested subcommands in the terminal with `-c` or `--config` arguments repeated across different levels, configuration overrides at each tier are now fully preserved instead of being accidentally overwritten or lost.

Queued prompts have also received updated execution logic, now reliably waiting for preceding pending permission menus to finish their selection before continuing execution. While corporate proxies or consecutive prompts once led to dropped connections or permission mix-ups, the entire command and scheduling pipeline now runs smoothly.

items.original:
Windows HTTPS and WebSocket connections now handle proxy authentication challenges using the signed-in user’s Negotiate or NTLM credentials. (#55994, #56000)
CLI configuration overrides are preserved when `-c` or `--config` appears at multiple subcommand levels. (#56022)
Queued prompts now wait for pending permission selections to resolve before continuing. (#55682)

title.zh-TW: 外掛的 API 金鑰可以設成選填
title.en: Plugin API Keys Can Now Be Optional

body.zh-TW:
你剛裝好一個串接網路服務的外掛，想先試試基本功能，手邊卻還沒申請帳號。現在外掛作者可以在外掛的 `auth.json` 裡，把某個 API 金鑰（向線上服務證明身分的存取密碼）提供者標記成選填，做法是在那一項加上 `"optional": true`。它適用於不用金鑰也能用、但附上金鑰能提高限流（服務限制單位時間內請求次數的機制）門檻的服務。

標成選填後，你還沒設定金鑰時，外掛指令會把存放金鑰的那個變數當成未設定，直接以免費的限流額度發出未驗證請求。以前同樣的情況會出現 `401` 錯誤，或跳出要你登入的畫面。⟦跟逛公立展覽館一樣，以前入口一律要看會員證，沒帶就被擋在門外；現在沒登記的訪客也能領普通號碼牌入場，出示會員卡則能換到更多參觀名額。⟧
body.en:
You've just installed a plugin that connects to an online service and want to try the basics, but you haven't signed up for an account yet. Plugin authors can now mark an API key (an access password that proves your identity to an online service) provider as optional in the plugin's `auth.json` by adding `"optional": true` to that entry. It is meant for services that work without a key but raise rate limits (caps on how many requests you can send per unit of time) when you have one.

Once a key is optional and you haven't set it, the plugin's commands see the variable holding the key as unset and make unauthenticated requests at the free rate limit. Before, the same situation failed with `401` errors or asked you to sign in. ⟦Think of a public exhibition hall: the entrance used to demand a membership card and turned away anyone without one; now walk-in visitors can take a regular ticket and enter, while members who show their card get a larger visiting allowance.⟧

items.original: Added `"optional": true` for API key providers in a plugin's `auth.json`, for services that work without a key but raise rate limits with one: when you haven't set the key, the plugin's commands now see the variable as unset and make unauthenticated requests at the free rate limit, instead of failing with `401` errors or asking you to sign in.

title.zh-TW: 串流中的長表格完成後才進捲動紀錄，邊框不再歪斜
title.en: Streamed Tables Now Reach Scrollback Only When Complete

body.zh-TW: 在終端機收到很長的回覆時，如果裡面有 Markdown 表格，往上翻常會看到版面亂掉。以前在串流（模型一邊生成一邊即時顯示）輸出時，表格列太早被推進捲動紀錄，也就是往上翻看得到的舊畫面，結果留下歪斜的邊框和重複的文字。現在表格各列會先留在即時畫面，等整張表格完成，才用最終欄寬推進捲動紀錄，往上翻就不會再看到錯位。
body.en: When you get a long reply in the terminal that contains a Markdown table, scrolling up often showed a broken layout. Before, while streaming (showing output in real time as the model generates it), table rows reached your terminal scrollback too early, leaving misaligned borders and repeated text. Now a table's rows stay in the live view until the table is complete, then reach scrollback with their final column widths, so scrolling up no longer shows the misalignment.

items.original: Fixed Markdown tables in long streaming replies leaving misaligned borders and repeated text in your terminal scrollback: a table's rows now stay in the live view until the table is complete, so they reach scrollback with their final column widths.

title.zh-TW: Google Cloud 登入支援自選計費模式，可挑 Gemini 訂閱制或隨用隨付
title.en: Google Cloud sign-in now supports selecting a billing model, allowing a choice between a Gemini subscription or Pay As You Go

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣使用 Google Cloud 帳號登入工具來處理專案，現在帳號綁定的付款機制多了清楚的選擇步驟。⟦跟到電信門市挑選門號資費一樣，以前完成登記後無法自選計費管道，現在你能依使用習慣挑選固定月租，或是用多少算多少的預付扣額。⟧以往透過 Google Cloud 登入時，無法在登入流程中直接決定開銷型態。現在只要完成 Google Cloud 登入驗證，畫面便會跳出計費模式選項。你可以直接勾選 Gemini 訂閱制（Gemini subscription）。如果偏好用多少算多少，也能挑選隨用隨付（Pay As You Go，按實際用量付費）方案。這讓你在登入當下就能敲定計費規則，避免扣款方式與預算規劃產生出入。
body.en: If you are used to signing into tools with a Google Cloud account to handle projects, the payment mechanism tied to your account now includes a clear selection step. ⟦Much like choosing a mobile plan at a telecom store, where you could not choose your billing channel after registering before, you can now pick a fixed monthly rate or pay-as-you-go prepaid credits based on your usage habits.⟧ Previously when signing in through Google Cloud, you could not decide your expense type directly in the sign-in flow. Now once Google Cloud sign-in authentication is complete, a billing model option appears on screen. You can directly select a Gemini subscription. If you prefer to pay for what you use, you can also select the Pay As You Go (paying only for what you use) plan. This lets you settle the billing rules right when signing in, preventing discrepancies between charges and budget plans.

items.original: Added a billing model choice after you sign in with Google Cloud, so you can pick either a Gemini subscription or Pay As You Go.

title.zh-TW: PreInvocation 掛鉤支援終止對話，攔截提示詞並回傳警示
title.en: PreInvocation hooks now support terminating turns to block prompts and return alerts

body.zh-TW: 當你在工具中設定自動檢查機制來保護機密時，現在能在送出請求的最前線精準把關。⟦如同機場託運安檢的掃描輸送帶，以前發現行李夾帶違禁品往往難以在中途攔截，現在能在送進貨艙前立刻截停，並向旅客出示退件通知單。⟧在 `PreInvocation` 掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）中，現在新增了 `terminationBehavior` 設定項。只要掛鉤回傳 `"terminate"`，就能在呼叫模型之前中止當前對話，例如及時攔截包含機敏資料的提示詞。掛鉤還能同時注入 `errorMessage` 物件，當中的 `userMessage` 訊息只會直接顯示在你的終端機畫面上，絕不會傳送給模型。若是透過 `-p` 參數執行的非互動流程，遇到終止時也會以非零狀態碼結束退出。
body.en: When configuring automated checks in the tool to protect confidential data, you can now maintain precise guardrails at the very front line of outgoing requests. ⟦Think of an airport baggage screening conveyor belt: whereas luggage containing contraband was previously hard to intercept midway, it can now be halted immediately before entering the cargo hold, presenting a return notice to the passenger.⟧ In `PreInvocation` hooks (small programs triggered by specific events), a new `terminationBehavior` setting has been added. As long as the hook returns `"terminate"`, it can stop the current turn before the model is called, such as blocking a prompt that contains sensitive data in time. The hook can also inject an `errorMessage` object at the same time, whose `userMessage` is shown directly on your terminal screen and is never sent to the model. If running a non-interactive flow via the `-p` flag, encountering a termination will also exit with a non-zero status code.

items.original: Added `terminationBehavior` to `PreInvocation` hooks: returning `"terminate"` stops the turn before the model is called, for example to block a prompt that contains sensitive data, and hooks can now inject an `errorMessage` whose `userMessage` is shown to you without being sent to the model, which also makes a `-p` run exit with a non-zero code.

title.zh-TW: JSON 輸出新增 finished_reason，精確標記提早中斷原因
title.en: JSON output adds finished_reason to accurately indicate why a turn ended early

body.zh-TW: 當你撰寫自動化腳本呼叫工具時，程式往往需要判斷回傳內容究竟有沒有講完。⟦好比自動櫃員機列印的明細表，以前交易中斷只能看著螢幕發愣，現在明細會印出逾時未領、手動取消還是連線異常，順利完成時則不留多餘標註。⟧現在使用 `--output-format json` 或 `stream-json` 格式輸出時，回傳結果新增了 `finished_reason` 欄位。如果執行過程因為 `--print-timeout` 時間耗盡而只產生部分回覆，該欄位會標示為 `print_timeout`。若因使用者按下 `Ctrl+C` 等操作取消執行，則會記錄為 `interrupted`。遭遇其他執行失敗時，會代入 `error`。這讓外部腳本能立刻釐清回答是被截斷還是完整輸出，而當對話正常結束時，輸出結果會直接省略此欄位。
body.en: When writing automated scripts to call the tool, programs often need to determine whether the returned content has finished speaking. ⟦An ATM receipt once left users staring at the screen during an interrupted transaction, but now prints whether it timed out, was manually canceled, or suffered a connection anomaly, leaving no extra notes when completed smoothly.⟧ Now when outputting with `--output-format json` or `stream-json`, a `finished_reason` field has been added to the returned results. If the execution produces only a partial response because `--print-timeout` expired, this field is marked as `print_timeout`. If the execution is canceled by user actions such as pressing `Ctrl+C`, it is recorded as `interrupted`. When encountering other execution failures, it is populated with `error`. This allows external scripts to immediately clarify whether an answer was cut off or output completely, while the field is omitted directly when the turn finishes normally.

items.original: Added a `finished_reason` field to the result of `--output-format json` and `stream-json` runs that says why a turn ended early, `print_timeout` when `--print-timeout` expired and the response is partial, `interrupted` when the run was canceled such as with `Ctrl+C`, or `error` for any other failure, so scripts can tell a cut-off answer from a complete one; the field is omitted when the turn finishes normally.

title.zh-TW: 外掛探索分頁支援分層收合，並修復 Claude 外掛匯入與 MCP 轉換
title.en: The plugin Discover tab supports collapsible shelves, fixing Claude plugin imports and MCP conversions

body.zh-TW:
當你想在工具中尋找或搬移外掛時，介面排版與轉換相容性現在都有了改善。⟦就像整理零件貨架，以前排面過長難以翻閱、外來套件也常因規格不符碰壁，現在分層收合清楚，規格也自動對齊。⟧在 `/plugin` 的 Discover 分頁中，每層架子只列出前 6 個外掛與展開列，並新增快捷操作：

```text
# 快速鍵操作
Ctrl+E                  # 展開或收合游標處架子
[ / ]                   # 跳至上一個或下一個架子

# 外掛匯入與 MCP 轉換
"type": "http"          # 保留含 url 與 headers 的遠端伺服器
.mcp.json               # 支援未含 mcpServers 包裹層的設定
${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}   # 自動展開為外掛安裝目錄
```

執行 `agy plugin import claude` 匯入 Claude Code 市集外掛時，不再誤報找不到擴充。現在會讀取安裝清單，並略過停用或單一專案專用的外掛。匯入時會保留遠端 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器與 `.mcp.json` 設定，若遇到舊版 SSE 等無法轉換的伺服器，會顯示警告而非回報為已安裝。
body.en:
When you want to search for or migrate plugins in the tool, interface layouts and conversion compatibility are now improved. ⟦Picture organizing a parts shelf: whereas excessively long displays were once cumbersome to browse and external packages frequently hit walls over mismatched specifications, shelves now collapse clearly into layers while specifications align automatically.⟧ In the Discover tab of `/plugin`, each shelf lists only its first 6 plugins along with an expand row, and introduces shortcut operations:

```text
# Shortcut operations
Ctrl+E                  # Expand or collapse the shelf under the cursor
[ / ]                   # Jump to the previous or next shelf

# Plugin import and MCP conversion
"type": "http"          # Retain remote servers with url and headers
.mcp.json               # Support configurations without an mcpServers wrapper
${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}   # Automatically expand to the plugin installation directory
```

When running `agy plugin import claude` to import Claude Code marketplace plugins, it no longer mistakenly reports that no extensions were found. It now reads the installation list, skipping disabled plugins or those dedicated to a single project. During import, remote MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) servers and `.mcp.json` configurations are retained. If it encounters servers that cannot be converted, such as legacy SSE, it displays a warning instead of reporting them as installed.

items.original:
Improved the `/plugin` Discover tab for long shelves: each shelf now shows its first 6 plugins followed by a `⋯ N more — enter to show` row, `Ctrl+E` expands or collapses the shelf under the cursor, and `[` and `]` jump to the previous or next shelf.
Fixed `agy plugin import claude` printing `No claude extensions found.` for plugins installed from a Claude Code marketplace: it now reads Claude Code's list of installed plugins, skipping plugins disabled in Claude Code's settings and plugins installed for a single project only, and imported plugins now keep their remote MCP servers (`"type": "http"` with `url` and `headers`) and servers from `.mcp.json` files without an `mcpServers` wrapper, expand `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` to the installed plugin's directory, and list servers that can't be converted, such as ones using the legacy SSE transport, with a warning instead of reporting them as installed.

title.zh-TW: 串流輸出改用終端回捲，連線傳輸減少約七成位元組
title.en: Streaming output switches to terminal scrollback, cutting transmitted bytes by about 70%

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端連線指揮工具工作時，終端機逐字跑出長篇回覆常會遇到畫面卡頓與延遲。⟦如同傳真機連續吐出紙張，新內容推進時直接讓舊頁面順著捲紙滾入底槽，不必每印一行就把整面白板擦掉重描。⟧以往串流輸出在文字超出螢幕頂端時，總會重新繪製整個終端機畫面。現在超出螢幕頂部的行數會直接滾入終端機的回捲緩衝區（scrollback，往上滾動查看歷史紀錄的區域）。文字折行也改為一次寫入整串連續文字，讓寫入終端機的傳輸量減少約 70% 位元組。即使透過慢速的 SSH 連線（Secure Shell，加密遠端連線協定）操作，接收長篇回覆也能維持滑順流暢。
body.en: When directing tools over a remote connection, watching a terminal print long replies word by word often runs into screen stutter and latency. ⟦Like a fax machine feeding paper continuously, incoming content lets older pages roll into the bottom tray along the paper feed instead of erasing and redrawing an entire whiteboard for every printed line.⟧ Previously, streaming output always repainted the entire terminal screen whenever text went past the top of the screen. Now, lines that scroll off the top of the screen scroll directly into the terminal's scrollback (an area for scrolling up to view history). Text wrapping also switches to writing whole runs of continuous text at a time, cutting the bytes written to the terminal by about 70%. Even when operating over a slow SSH connection (Secure Shell, an encrypted remote connection protocol), receiving long replies stays smooth and fluid.

items.original: Improved streaming of agent replies: lines that scroll off the top of the screen are now scrolled into your terminal's scrollback instead of repainting the whole screen, and text wrapping writes whole runs of text at a time, so streaming writes about 70% fewer bytes to the terminal and stays much smoother over slow SSH connections.

title.zh-TW: 互動介面開啟十五秒後，自動歸還啟動殘留記憶體
title.en: Startup memory returned automatically fifteen seconds after interactive UI opens

body.zh-TW: 開啟終端機工具並常駐在背景時，程式佔用的硬體資源往往會影響電腦的整體流暢度。⟦跟大型演出進場一樣，工作人員在開演前搬進大量裝箱工具，等到演出開始十五秒後，便把卸貨的推車撤出場館，將走道空間交還給大樓。⟧以往命令列介面在完成初始化後，載入過程所消耗的暫存記憶體會一直被工具佔用。現在只要互動式介面開啟 15 秒，工具就會主動把啟動階段殘留的約 100 MB 記憶體歸還給作業系統。如果你是透過列印模式，或是無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）執行一次性指令，運作行為則不受影響。
body.en: When opening a terminal tool and keeping it running in the background, the hardware resources consumed by the program often affect overall system responsiveness. ⟦In a large stage production setup, stagehands haul in stacks of boxed tools before showtime, and fifteen seconds after the performance begins, they wheel the unloading carts out of the venue to return aisle space to the building.⟧ Previously, after the command line interface finished initialization, the temporary memory consumed during the loading process remained occupied by the tool. Now, fifteen seconds after the interactive UI opens, the tool actively returns about 100 MB of memory left over from the startup phase to the operating system. If you run one-off commands through print mode or headless mode (an execution mode without a terminal window), operation remains unaffected.

items.original: Improved memory use shortly after startup: the CLI now returns about 100 MB of memory left over from startup to the operating system 15 seconds after the interactive UI opens; print and headless modes are unaffected.

title.zh-TW: 壓縮對話納入附加快照估算，子代理摘要保留上層任務
title.en: Compacted conversations count attached snapshots, and subagent summaries preserve parent tasks

body.zh-TW: 想要在長對話中執行 `/compact` 壓縮歷史紀錄，或是交由子代理分頭處理複雜專案，精簡上下文之餘更要確保資訊不漏失。⟦好比專案交接整理摘要，以前只計算備忘錄字數而漏算隨附圖表，助理甚至在精簡時忘記委託人編號；現在清單如實計入所有附件重量，並完整保留指派人交付的任務與最新叮嚀。⟧以前壓縮標記與 `/context` 顯示的壓縮後數值，只計算了純摘要本身。現在統計會納入摘要帶入下一輪提示的所有內容，包含早先的請求，以及產出物、子代理與執行中任務的快照，讓數值更貼近真實大小；標籤 `(N summary)` 則維持單獨標示純摘要。過去子代理在上下文經過壓縮後（包含使用 `/compact`），容易遺失上層代理指派的任務與上層 ID。現在子代理的摘要會保留原任務與上層識別碼，並留存上層代理最近 10 則訊息。
body.en: When running `/compact` to compress history in long conversations or handing off complex projects to subagents, trimming context must never come at the cost of losing information. ⟦Picture a project handover briefing. Previously, staff counted only the memo words while overlooking attached diagrams, and the assistant even dropped the client ID when condensing notes. Now the manifest faithfully tallies the weight of all attachments while fully preserving the assigner's delegated task and latest reminders.⟧ Previously, the after-compaction size shown in the compaction marker and in `/context` counted only the pure summary itself. Now the tally includes everything the summary carries into the next prompt, such as your earlier requests along with artifact, subagent, and running-task snapshots, bringing the figure closer to the real size. The `(N summary)` label continues to show the summary alone. In the past, subagents often lost the task assigned by their parent agent and the parent ID after their context was compacted (including when using `/compact`). A subagent's summary now preserves the original task and parent ID, while keeping the parent agent's 10 most recent messages.

items.original:
Improved the after-compaction size shown in the compaction marker and in `/context` to also count what the summary carries into the next prompt, such as your earlier requests and artifact, subagent, and running-task snapshots, so it is closer to the real size; the `(N summary)` label still shows the summary alone.
Fixed subagents losing the task their parent agent gave them, and the parent's ID, after their context was compacted, including with `/compact`; a subagent's summary now keeps the parent agent's 10 most recent messages.

title.zh-TW: 對話圖檔限制兩千像素並自動轉檔，避免超出請求上限
title.en: Conversation images capped at 2000 pixels and converted automatically to avoid request limits

body.zh-TW: 在對話中貼上多張高解析度截圖或照片時，送出請求常會因為資料量過大而遭到模型直接拒絕。⟦就像郵局寄送包裹，以前包裹只要尺寸超標或貼錯標籤就會直接退件；現在收件窗口會先幫超大包裹修剪體積，在不影響內容下把厚重包裝換成輕便紙袋，遇到標籤貼錯的信件也主動辨識放行。⟧現在輸入對話的圖片每邊最長會被限制在 2000 像素以內。體積較大的 PNG 圖片若轉為 JPEG 能明顯縮減大小，便會自動改以 JPEG 格式傳送。針對剪貼簿貼上的圖片或瀏覽器截圖，如果檔案本體是 JPEG 卻被標記成 PNG，工具也不會再因為型別不一致而拒絕請求。
body.en: When pasting multiple high-resolution screenshots or photos into a conversation, sending requests often led to outright rejection by the model due to excessive payload size. ⟦At a postal parcel counter, packages exceeding dimensions or bearing mismatched labels were once returned immediately. Now, counter staff trim down oversized parcels first, swapping heavy packaging for lightweight mailers without altering the contents, and actively identify mislabeled letters to let them pass.⟧ Images entered into conversations are now capped at 2000 pixels per side. Large PNG images that become significantly smaller when converted to JPEG are now automatically sent in JPEG format. For images pasted from the clipboard or browser screenshots where the file is actually a JPEG but labeled PNG, the tool no longer rejects requests because of a mismatched type.

items.original: Fixed conversations with many or large images, such as screenshots or pasted images, being rejected for exceeding the model's request size limit: images are now capped at 2000 pixels per side and large PNGs are sent as JPEGs when that is much smaller, and an image saved as JPEG but labeled PNG, such as a pasted image or browser screenshot, is no longer rejected for a mismatched type.

title.zh-TW: 修復瀏覽器子代理在無痕與隔離視窗下遺漏頁面快照
title.en: Fixed browser subagent missing page snapshots in Incognito and isolated contexts

body.zh-TW: 如果請 `/browser` 子代理操作特定網頁，遇到以 `isolatedContext` 開啟的頁面或附加自無痕視窗（Incognito）等隔離環境，以前子代理會抓不到當前頁面的快照。這個問題已經修好，子代理現在能正常接收該頁面的快照資訊。
body.en: When asking the `/browser` subagent to operate on a specific page that belongs to an isolated environment, such as a page opened with `isolatedContext` or attached from an Incognito window, the subagent previously failed to capture snapshots of the current page. This issue has been fixed, and the subagent now receives the page's snapshot information normally.

items.original: Fixed the `/browser` subagent not receiving the current page's snapshot when the selected page belongs to an isolated browser context, such as a page opened with `isolatedContext` or attached from an Incognito window.

title.zh-TW: 已回答的問題之間自動加入空行，精簡模式維持緊湊排版
title.en: Answered questions now automatically include a blank line between them, while compact mode preserves a tight layout

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機連續向 AI 提出多個問題時，畫面上常常累積了長長一串對話紀錄。以前每輪問答緊密相接，文字擠在一起時很難一眼看清每個問題的段落邊界。⟦就像參觀藝廊時欣賞牆上的攝影作品，以前每幅照片緊緊挨著張貼，視線容易把不同主題混成一團；現在每組作品之間留出均勻空隙，瀏覽時就能立刻辨識各個段落的分界。⟧現在終端機處理完提問後，會在各個已回答的問題之間自動加入一行空白行。多了一行留白後，不論前一個問題的回答有多長，你都能一眼找出上一段問答的結尾。唯一的例外是當你開啟精簡模式（`/compact-mode`）時，介面會維持原有的緊湊排版而不加入空行，讓你在高度有限的視窗中能同時看到更多對話內容。
body.en: When you ask an AI multiple questions in a row in the terminal, a long conversation history often accumulates on the screen. Previously, each round of questions and answers sat flush against the next, making it difficult to clearly see the boundaries of each question when the text was packed tightly together. ⟦Picture browsing photography on an art gallery wall: previously, photos hung directly edge to edge, so your eyes could easily blur different themes together; now, even gaps between exhibits let you immediately spot where each section divides.⟧ Now, after the terminal finishes processing your questions, answered questions now have a blank line between them. With this extra blank line, no matter how long the previous answer was, you can easily locate the end of the prior exchange at a glance. The only exception is when you enable compact mode (`/compact-mode`), where the interface maintains its original tight layout without adding blank lines, allowing you to view more conversation content at once in a window with limited height.

items.original: Answered questions now have a blank line between them, except in compact mode (`/compact-mode`)

title.zh-TW: `/plugins` 僅計算成功載入的技能，並標明因外部連結略過的數量
title.en: `/plugins` now counts only plugin skills that load, and indicates how many were skipped because they link outside the plugin folder

body.zh-TW: 想確認外掛擴充功能有沒有正確啟用，最直接的方法就是打 `/plugins` 檢視終端機列出的統計數字。以前統計時可能連同未成功載入的項目一併計算，讓人難以一眼確認哪些技能真正可以使用。現在輸入 `/plugins` 檢視時，工具只會統計成功載入的外掛技能。如果有任何技能因為連結到外掛資料夾外部而被略過，介面也會清楚標示具體略過了多少個項目。看清實際載入的數量，能幫助你立刻掌握外掛規模，並在數字短少時及時檢查檔案路徑。⟦好比運動會檢錄處清點參賽選手，以前名冊上只要有名字就全部算進報到人數，現在裁判只登錄順利踏入指定檢錄區的人員，並在看板寫明有多少人因跑出指定線外而未計入出場名單。⟧
body.en: The most direct way to confirm whether plugin extensions are enabled correctly is to run `/plugins` to check the statistics displayed in the terminal. Previously, tallies might include items that failed to load, making it hard to see at a glance which skills were actually usable. Now when you run `/plugins`, it counts only the plugin skills that load. If any skills are skipped because they link outside the plugin folder, the interface clearly indicates exactly how many items were skipped. Seeing the actual number of loaded skills helps you immediately gauge plugin scale and promptly inspect file paths if counts fall short. ⟦At a sports meet registration desk tallying competitors, officials previously counted every name on the roster toward attendance; now, referees record only athletes who successfully step into the designated check-in area, while posting on the board how many were excluded from the roster for running outside the boundary lines.⟧

items.original: `/plugins` now counts only the plugin skills that load, and says how many were skipped because they link outside the plugin folder

title.zh-TW: 儀表板將位置列整併至邊框，目錄分組新增路徑與代理數量標頭
title.en: Dashboard Merges Location Row into Border, Directory Grouping Adds Path and Agent Count Headers

body.zh-TW: 在終端機開啟儀表板管理多個專案時，查看分支與各目錄代理分布變得十分直覺。⟦如同走進規劃整齊的檔案庫，以前每張桌子都要立一塊大立牌寫專案名稱，現在直接把分處標籤壓印在收件盒上框，每個資料夾分格上方也清楚貼上部門路徑與文件總數。⟧以往顯示所在分支與資料夾的位置資訊會單獨占用一整列標頭，現在這項資訊直接嵌入發送框的頂部邊框，不再浪費額外的版面空間。當儀表板依目錄將代理分組時，每個代理資料夾上方都會標示獨立的標頭，具體列出資料夾路徑以及該資料夾擁有的代理數量。切換視窗時一眼就能掌握所在工作區與代理配置，不必在清單裡費力辨識。
